hardware: MacBook Pro (Apple M3 Max, 36 GB RAM, macOS 15.6); Go 1.27.1; Postgres 17 (testcontainers); test run single-threaded on one machine

scenarios.name: proxy-drops-latency
scenarios.description: Proxy injects 5% packet drops and 30 ms added latency between workers and Postgres for the full test duration.

scenarios.name: postgres-restart
scenarios.description: At t≈1.5 s the Postgres container is stopped then started (dns preserved). Workers reconnect through the proxy.

scenarios.name: worker-sigkill
scenarios.description: At t≈4 s worker 1 (of 3) receives SIGKILL. Its lease expires, the reaper moves the job to retryable, another worker picks it up.

scenarios.name: worker-sigstop-cont
scenarios.description: At t≈5.5 s worker 2 receives SIGSTOP for 3 s, then SIGCONT. The lease expires during the stop; the reaper re-promotes the job, and the resumed worker gracefully cancels its stale lease.

requirements: postgres:17-alpine image pulled (auto on first run)
reproduction.notes: The test builds the harness-worker binary to /tmp, starts 3 worker processes, runs a faultproxy (drop 5%, +30 ms latency), restarts the testcontainers Postgres, sends SIGKILL and SIGSTOP/SIGCONT to workers, and finally runs the checker. The checker verifies every job completed exactly once and the ledger has one row per job with the correct fencing token.
